UO ARENA - quick demo build
===========================

TO PLAY
  Double-click UOArena.exe

  Windows will probably show a blue "Windows protected your PC" box, because
  this is an unsigned hobby build. Click "More info", then "Run anyway".

  Keep both files in the same folder - the .exe needs the .pck next to it.


CONTROLS
  Hold RIGHT MOUSE   walk toward the cursor (you can move while casting)
  1 2 3 4 5          magic arrow / poison / lightning / flamestrike / paralyze
  R                  reset the round
  Alt+F4             quit


WHAT AM I LOOKING AT
  You are the blue circle on the left. The pink one is a practice dummy that
  casts magic arrow at you on a loop.

  The line between you is the game's actual line-of-sight check. A solid line
  means there is a clear shot; a dashed one means cover is breaking it.

  While someone casts, they speak the spell's words overhead - "Kal Vas Flam"
  is a flamestrike, and it takes 2.5 seconds. That is your warning to get
  behind a tent.


TRY THIS
  1. Stand still in the open and hold 4. You will get interrupted every time.
	 Any damage breaks a cast, and there is no refund.

  2. Press 4, then immediately press 3. The flamestrike fizzles into a
	 lightning. Spam it and you will cast nothing at all - that is deliberate,
	 and it is also how you bait someone into dodging early.

  3. Walk off the middle lane while the dummy is casting. Watch the line go
	 dashed and its spells stop landing.


This is an early prototype - one arena, one dummy, no multiplayer yet.
